narration.full_text: Namaste, students! In this section, we're going to embark on an exciting journey to understand how living organisms manage control and coordination. We'll explore the intricate mechanisms that allow them to respond to their environment and maintain balance. Our key learning objectives for this section include: First, we will delve into the fascinating human nervous system, understanding the roles of neurons, reflex actions, and the brain. Next, we'll discover the unique ways plants coordinate their growth and respond to various stimuli. Finally, we'll learn about the endocrine system in animals and the crucial role hormones play in regulating bodily functions.
